tasks.title: Task 1: trace one flow and agree what "correct" means
steps: Open the legacy code: source tables, procedure, shared package, schedule.
Trace the flow and check each answer against the code.
Agree the rules with your business owner.
Note what else the shared package loads.

done_when.label: Lineage worksheet filled in, each line backed by the code

tasks.watch_for: Migrating one dataset alone doesn't free the shared package.

tasks.title: Task 2: convert, review, save and run
tasks.kicker: 50 minutes · your saved files are what gets scored
steps: Convert one view or procedure and review the differences.
Draft the stage view and framework YAML.
Save the files in your team area.
Run your files.
tasks.watch_for: No conversion access? Use the prepared example.

tasks.title: Task 3: find what's wrong, and what's just different
steps: Open the first scorecard.
Investigate with affected keys and sample rows.
Classify every difference.
Fix your files and run again.

done_when.label: Every difference has an owner and evidence

tasks.watch_for: Matching row counts don't prove values belong to the right record.

tasks.title: Task 4: prove your test catches a bad result
tasks.kicker: 35 minutes · a useful test rejects a bad result
steps: Write one validation rule.
Break your own copy on purpose.
Run it: the gate should reject that exact run.
Repair, run again, swap drivers.
tasks.watch_for: A check that can't measure must fail, not pass.
